subject: Re: Status: alignment-metric repro + one risk
body:
Thanks Rafael. Decision from yesterday's sync: we cut SVHN from the May scope. Dogfood on Apr 20 ships with CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 only; SVHN moves to a fast-follow once ingestion stabilizes. Rationale: the per-dataset calibration risk you raised is the real work, and I'd rather spend Amara's cycles there than on a third loader.

For launch review (Apr 29 slot with Nadia's board) I need: the alignment-threshold writeup, the two-dataset dogfood results, and a one-pager on how this lands in the Corpus dashboard. Ivo — please confirm staffing holds through the review; no change to the 40TB scratch ask.

One more thing: keep the word memorization out of customer-facing copy until legal has seen it. "Training diagnostics" is fine.

Dmitri
